If anyone ever tells you the system for getting help for mental health, anxiety, depression and ADHD in Ontario works, please tell them they're wrong. They are very, VERY wrong. #Ontario #onelxn #ygk #canada

A few years ago, I used this very platform to share a post I'd written about depression. That's a fight I still struggle with. I'm winning, for now, but we've had a few close calls. Some of the friends I've made here have been instrumental in this fight.

Listening to the new #TheLionKing soundtrack. It's everything I needed it to be: goosebumps, tears, chills, fear. It's incredible. If the movie is following this same path.... I don't know that my heart can take it.

I have called the AMHS-KFLA crisis line. Many times. For my own trauma, for my own anxiety, for my own crisis moments. For this. They have never not been courteous, professional and HELPFUL in my calls. If you need them, #ygk, you're not alone.

When they're not, having to talk with two officers in full uniform - vests, weapons, radios, etc - can be and has been incredibly intimidating - certainly not the feeling you're looking for in a moment of panic or crisis when adrenaline is already at peak. 4/

I'd like to share my own, quite personal perspective here. I have struggled with depression and ADHD for years - many of those years went undiagnosed and untreated. They have lead to more anxiety attacks and crisis situations than I'm comfortable sharing. 1/
